==Description==
The '''Frost Hero''' was the final enemy to appear on Insane mode.

It had more health than the [[Gravekeeper]]. It could therefore be considered a major boss due to this, and the fact that it was immune to the [[Freezer]]'s ''Ice Drop'' ability, which only major bosses were immune. However, the '''Frost Hero''' was duplicated on two-pathed maps, such as [[Badlands]], unlike other major bosses.

The '''Frost Hero''' could smash its hammer into the ground near towers, stunning them for a period of time. 

==Appearance==
The '''Frost Hero''' wore a sky blue dominus, with sky blue skull shoulder-pads. It had a similar appearance in appearance to the [[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]]. Instead of having a face, its head was illuminated blue. Its skin was baby blue, and its torso and legs were sky blue. Its skin, torso and legs were in the ice texture. It wielded an ice hammer to attack towers.

==Strategy==
*The [[Pyromancer]] can be used to slow the '''Frost Hero''' to allow your towers more time to kill it.
*Cheap towers, such as the [[Scout]], can easily distract this enemy, keeping your main towers attacking.
*If you can, try to place your towers away from the path, as the '''Frost Hero's''' ''Ice Hammer'' range is quite short.
**If you cannot do so, try to place your towers separated from each other. If they are grouped together, they are all at risk of being stunned by one attack.
*As usual, high DPS towers, such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Commando]] and [[Turret]], are recommended.
*[[Ranger|Outlaws]] and [[Rocketeer|Rocketers]] are recommended against this enemy as they appear two and three times during wave 67 and wave 68.
**You can use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to decrease the firerate of these towers.
**You can also use the [[Militant|John's]] ''Gorilla Noises'' ability to increase the damage of these towers.

==Trivia==
*Due to a bug, the '''Frost Hero''' was initially not immune to the [[Freezer]]'s ''Freeze Drop'' ability.
*The '''Frost Hero's''' hammer was the {{RLinkC|15970544|Harbinger of Fimbulwinter}} gear from the Roblox catalog.
*The skull shoulder pads used by the '''Frost Hero''' are the {{RLinkC|6552254|The Ice Skull of Nevermoor}} accessory from the Roblox catalog.
